overview: A sovereign Nation OS platform where communities launch their own constitutionally governed digital nation with a three-authority founding council.
features: Launch a Nation OS through a guided six-step wizard
Sign in with Internet Identity to become Founding Authority #1
Resume a partially completed launch without creating a duplicate Nation
See which founding seat your signed-in account holds
Invite and confirm two further founding authorities before activation
Governance, discussions, members, documents, calendar and treasury apps inside each Nation
